title: WASH Cluster: Gap List v2, Request to HRI for G-W-01 Buzi

fields.subject: GAP LIST v2 – REQUEST TO HRI – G-W-01 Buzi – reply by 12:00
fields.body:
Dear colleagues,

First, very glad to hear your Buzi team is safe.

HRI is a WASH cluster member and co-leads the Zambezia sub-group. Your team was in Buzi on Thursday, so you know the boreholes. I am formally asking HRI to take G-W-01: safe water and emergency latrines, Buzi post and Estaquinha post, est. 18,000 people (INGD figure, unverified). The assignment target is 19:30 today. No other WASH partner has staff or kit for Buzi. If HRI declines, I must report the line as unassigned at tonight's cluster call, and it goes to the HCT as an escalation on Sunday.

To assign the line I need these in writing: the units to be deployed, the named staff, the access route (UNHAS or INGD boat) and the first service date. The first service must be before 07:30 Sunday.

For reference, your signed Recount 1 (attached) shows 10 usable portable water treatment units plus 2 untested, 2,400 usable shelter kits, 3,180 usable hygiene kits, 2,260 usable jerrycans, and dry water tablets for 20,000 people for 60 days.

Separately, the Shelter cluster says the Logistics Cluster sheet still lists HRI with 3,000 shelter kits. They ask whether HRI will take G-S-02 Nhamatanda (est. 3,500 households), in full or in part. Please answer both by 12:00.

Regards,
fields.signature:
WASH Cluster Coordinator
TC Tevra Response – Sofala and Zambezia
WASH Cluster Coordination Cell, Beira

instructorNote: This is a decision point. By 12:00 the CD, advised by the SFP and using LOG's figures, must decide whether HRI takes G-W-01. Taking it means a Level 3 movement approval, a team on UNHAS rotation 3 and some of the 10 tested units committed. Staff would also go back into the area they just left. Watch whether the written reply names an owner, the stock and a first service date, and says what this means for the national staff deployed. Also check that any Nhamatanda offer stays at or under the 2,400 usable kits, not the 3,000 still on the cluster sheet.
